criteria.original_text:
BUB001-01 在 owner 选定的基线版本安装、启动、重载、卸载均有运行证据；不支持版本显示具体差异和处
理建议，不半初始化后接受任务。
criteria.requirement_english: On the selected baseline, installation, start, reload and uninstall have actual evidence; unsupported versions show specific differences and remedies and admit no half-initialized work.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Earlier physical installed Web package loaded, reloaded and uninstalled with genuine native authentication; C1 incorporation is source-only.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current physical installation/start/reload/uninstall and unsupported-version diagnostics, with selected build proof independently assessed; Q01 restart alone covers only part.

criteria.original_text: BUB001-02 连续 10 次重载后，一个输入只产生一个入口记录；无残留监听、重复调度或新增孤儿工作会话。
criteria.requirement_english: Ten consecutive reloads yield one entry record per input, without residual listeners, duplicate schedules or new orphan workers.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical installed runs performed ten Loader reloads, deduplicated intake and observed old-reference disposal; NI1 also reloaded memory/context.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Ten fresh current installed reloads with one-input/one-entry, schedule/listener counts and owned worker/agent-session absence. Q01 has two starts, not ten reloads.

criteria.original_text: BUB001-03 缺失必要会话或权限服务时，不执行相关任务；诊断标明实际检测结果，不能只看版本字符串。
criteria.requirement_english: Missing required session or permission services stops dependent work; diagnostics show actual detections rather than version strings.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical public service/readiness negatives and default-deny carrier; R13 genuine ready worker under its exact available services.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current missing-session and missing-permission negatives with safe detected facts and zero dependent work. Disabled entry or invalid storage does not replace these feature failures.

criteria.original_text:
BUB001-04 关闭窗口后用宿主状态确认是否仍运行；完整退出后插件停止。重新启动由 BUB003 对账恢复，
不盲目重发外部动作。
criteria.requirement_english: Window closure is checked against host running state; full exit stops the plugin; restart reconciles under BUB003 without blind external replay.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Earlier installed idle stop/restart retained one task; R13 stopped its worker before cleanup and restarted a standalone Cordis root.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current original-CLI terminal joins before forced exit, retained-store reconciliation and no replay; actual window-close host-state observation remains browser-blocked. Active/unknown-effect recovery is separate from the selected idle restart.

criteria.original_text:
BUB001-05 同一配置在 Desktop 与 CLI 上分别记录已验证、未验证或不适用；文档不以一端成功代替另一端
兼容。
criteria.requirement_english: Record Desktop and CLI compatibility separately for the same configuration as verified, unverified or not applicable; one carrier's success proves no other carrier.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Documentary criterion: pinned Web is explicit, Desktop excluded by owner and interactive/non-Web CLI unverified; no runtime equivalence asserted.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current compatibility and owner-scope identities must remain exact; no additional carrier run is required merely to document unverified or not-applicable status.

criteria.original_text:
BUB002-01 主对话接收同一 provider message id 的重复投递只建立一个入口；用户刻意重发但拥有新 id 的
消息保留，不按文本相同误删。
criteria.requirement_english: Duplicate delivery with the same provider message ID creates one entry; a deliberate new-ID message survives despite identical text.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual store replay/new-ID tests and earlier native single-source duplicate intake; no real chat provider claim.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current new-ID/same-text and full source-identity collision tests alongside Q01 duplicate intake; live-provider transport portion is owner-deferred.

criteria.original_text: BUB002-02 同一任务运行时用户修改约束，任务版本递增；后续工作看到新版本，旧结果不得覆盖新要求。
criteria.requirement_english: A correction during running work increments task version, reaches subsequent work and prevents old results overwriting new requirements.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual store revision/process CAS and stale completion/context tests; NI1 retained current constraints; R13 one fixed-version execution.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current executing-worker correction and subsequent-input/late-result race. A fixed-version W01 pass does not exercise correction during execution.

criteria.original_text:
BUB002-03 用户说停止时先停止新派发，再请求 DSH 取消；呈现已请求、已停止或结果不确定，不能在未确
认时写已取消。
criteria.requirement_english: Stop first fences new dispatch, then requests native cancellation; requested, stopped and unknown remain distinct until confirmation.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual module commit-before-cancel and retained unknown reservations; R13 factual original worker stop and registry absence before cleanup.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current user-stop versus dispatch/completion/unknown-effect ordering and visible requested/confirmed/unknown states; normal finish and idle quit cover only part.

criteria.original_text:
BUB002-04 新问题与长任务并发时，无须等待整个工作会话结束才能接收输入和查询状态；响应性能在
BUB012 的选定环境下测量。
criteria.requirement_english: During long work, new input and status queries do not await the entire worker session; measure response performance in the BUB012 selected environment.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual module pending classifier/cancellation tests leave inbox/status available; no selected-environment latency result.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Concurrent long-worker input/status experiment with frozen environment and recorded response latency. One isolated successful W01 provides no concurrent responsiveness measurement.

criteria.original_text:
BUB002-05 确需澄清时，把相关决策一次汇总；可从已有上下文确定的事项不重复追问，也不把沉默当批
准。
criteria.requirement_english: Bundle necessary clarification decisions, avoid asking what context already resolves and never interpret silence as approval.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual SQLite clarification batches, durable answers, filtering and stale/silent-answer refusal.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported clarification input/display, attributable answers and branch continuation using the same authority ledger.

criteria.original_text:
BUB003-01 在登记前、登记后派发前、派发后回执前、动作完成后落盘前注入故障。持久受理后的任务必须
可恢复；受理前仅在来源支持回放时可补收，否则声明接收缺口，不确认已受理；回执缺失不盲目重做动作。
criteria.requirement_english: Inject faults before intake, after intake before dispatch, after dispatch before receipt and after effect before persistence; recover durable admissions, declare unsupported pre-admission gaps and never blindly repeat unknown effects.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical OS-process CAS/precommit/postack recovery and durable native task/context retention; R13 successful acknowledged worker execution.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: All four current integrated fault cuts, source replay-or-gap distinction and effect reconciliation. Q01 idle acknowledged restart and W01 clean finish do not cover the cut matrix.

criteria.original_text:
BUB003-02 两个入口或 worker 并发更新同一任务时，以版本检查拒绝旧写入；历史保留变化原因与证据，完
成态不得被旧进度倒退。
criteria.requirement_english: Concurrent entries or workers use version checks to reject stale writes, retain reasons/evidence and never regress terminal state.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual process CAS winner/loser/readback and stale completion/control tests on historical stores.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current multi-entry/worker process race, historical reason evidence and terminal-versus-late-progress assertion; N01 duplicate execute is a different oracle.

criteria.original_text:
BUB003-03 磁盘不可写、存储损坏或空间不足时，显式进入受限状态，停止需持久保证的新操作并提示风
险。
criteria.requirement_english: Unwritable, corrupt or full storage enters a visible restricted state, stops new durable operations and warns of risk.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical corruption/key/rollback/fail-closed storage tests; earlier native overflow and rejected setup preserve state.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current unwritable/corrupt/full storage cases after admission and readable restriction diagnostics. Q03 shallow invalid path is only an early setup-failure subset.

criteria.original_text:
BUB003-04 升级迁移前保存可恢复副本；新旧 schema、不完整迁移及回滚均有测试，不覆盖不能理解的数
据。
criteria.requirement_english: Keep a recoverable copy before migration; test old/new schema, incomplete migration and rollback and do not overwrite unknown data.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual historical schema/WAL/hot-journal and backup/key/tamper/legacy-refusal cases; no current C1 upgrade run.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current canonical migration/backup/incomplete/rollback matrix with durable conservation. The successful four-command build is no migration evidence.

criteria.original_text:
BUB003-05 导出包含状态、来源、时间与产物引用；删除后禁止重新调度，按确认的保留范围清理，不能把
无法控制的第三方副本宣称删除。
criteria.requirement_english: Export includes state, source, time and artifact references; deletion prevents rescheduling and respects confirmed retention without claiming third-party copies erased.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical authoritative store/export/delete module coverage and memory tombstone tests; no complete current installed export/deletion journey.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current installed export contents, consented retention cleanup, post-delete no-reschedule and honest third-party-copy limitation.

criteria.original_text:
BUB004-01 分别显示创建请求已受理、会话已创建、ready、执行中、结束或状态未知；每一步都有真实服务
响应或状态证据。
criteria.requirement_english: Distinguish create-request acceptance, created, ready, running, ended and unknown, each supported by genuine service response or state.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical native lifecycle partitions; R13 genuine ready/execute/capture/factual-stopped positive path.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current positive transitions plus create-accepted/created/not-ready/unknown service partitions and their visible states. W01 alone cannot establish every partition.

criteria.original_text:
BUB004-02 创建超时但随后发现会话存在时，关联已有会话，不重复创建第二个执行者；无法判定时保持核
查态。
criteria.requirement_english: If creation times out but a session later exists, associate it without creating another executor; unresolved identity stays under verification.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical late-create/no-second-executor module coverage; R13 one successful creation and one execute.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current genuine delayed-create discovery, immutable association and zero second executor; N01 prevents duplicate execute after acknowledgement but is not a create-timeout test.

criteria.original_text:
BUB004-03 恢复既有会话后执行一项可观察工作并得到产物；不存在或不属于当前授权范围的 session 不恢
复。
criteria.requirement_english: Resume an existing authorized session, execute observable work and obtain an artifact; missing or unauthorized sessions are not resumed.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical genuine public AgentLoop JSONL resume used a new approved claim/generation and current context to produce one new committed result; separate mock-persistence case was labelled mock.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Fresh genuine supported existing-session resume with observable result and missing/foreign-session negatives. W01 creates a new session.

criteria.original_text:
BUB004-04 取消请求与完成并发时，保留实际已完成效果与晚到结果；不宣称已经撤销外部发送、文件修改
等既成效果。
criteria.requirement_english: Cancellation racing completion preserves actual effects and late results and never claims completed sends or file changes were undone.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical cancel/late-result and unknown-delivery tests; R13 normal factual stop, not a cancellation race.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current genuine cancel-versus-complete race with factual effect/late-result evidence and correct uncertainty. Tools0 normal finish proves no file/send race.

criteria.original_text: BUB004-05 事件流断开后通过当前查询与账本对账；重新订阅不会把历史事件当新任务，也不会丢失终态。
criteria.requirement_english: After event-feed loss, query current host state and reconcile ledger; resubscription neither creates tasks from history nor loses terminal state.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical public-library feed/current-query/history-replay tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported native feed-disconnect/resubscribe/query lifecycle, retained terminal fact and no new task from historical events.

criteria.original_text:
BUB005-01 父子会话的状态回报可到达已授权父会话；无关会话未经明确 grant 发送消息时被拒绝，并留下
不含秘密的拒绝理由。
criteria.requirement_english: Authorized parent sessions receive child status; unrelated ungranted messages are denied with secret-free reasons.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual scoped SQLite broker and public-library native messaging negatives; no current genuine parent-recipient observation.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current authorized parent/child receipt plus ungranted unrelated-session refusal and redacted reason; one worker result is not parent-message consumption.

criteria.original_text:
BUB005-02 grant 绑定任务或有界会话集合与消息类别；校验与派发记录绑定同一授权版本，定义撤销和派发
的先后判定点。撤销先发生则拒绝；已提交动作标为在途，不宣称撤回既成效果。
criteria.requirement_english: Grants bind task or bounded sessions and category; dispatch and revoke share an authorization-version decision point, with committed work retained as in flight.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual compound claim/outbox, scoped grant and revoke-before/after-claim partitions on historical dependencies.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current bound grant/dispatch/revoke concurrency across native transport, including committed in-flight reconciliation rather than false withdrawal.

criteria.original_text:
BUB005-03 按完整作用域和持久消息记录防止已知重复派发；消费状态未知时先核查，不盲目重发，不宣称
接收方 exactly once。乱序消息不能覆盖更高任务版本；无唯一 id 时明示降级。
criteria.requirement_english: Durable fully scoped identity prevents known duplicate dispatch; unknown consumption is checked first, order cannot replace newer task versions and missing IDs expose degraded guarantees.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual immutable-ID conflict, unknown timeout/reopen/no resend and held reservations; higher-version/control guards.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current crash/order/missing-ID transport partitions and recipient query, without an arbitrary-receiver exactly-once claim.

criteria.original_text: BUB005-04 消息经过多个会话转发时保留原始来源和用途，并设置跳数或循环检测；出现循环时停止放大。
criteria.requirement_english: Forwarding preserves original source and purpose and enforces hop bounds or cycle detection to stop amplification.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual SQLite two-hop provenance, bounded relay and loop-refusal tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current native multi-session forwarding with source/purpose preservation and cycle/hop-limit refusal.

criteria.original_text:
BUB005-05 accepted、已写入发件箱、sent、目标确认消费分别可见；超时只是状态未知或未确认，不自动
写成已送达。
criteria.requirement_english: Accepted, durable outbox, sent and target-confirmed consumption are separate observable facts; timeout remains unknown or unconfirmed.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual store/facade accepted/sent/unknown/reconcile distinctions using explicit synthetic recipients.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current native recipient consumption and truthful displayed transport states; synthetic contract evidence remains valid only for its bounded contract.

criteria.original_text:
BUB006-01 未绑定身份、冒名渠道账户、跨 workspace 请求和伪造 webhook 均不执行；为每类拒绝建立正
反测试。
criteria.requirement_english: Unbound identity, spoofed accounts, foreign workspace and forged webhooks never execute; every rejection class has positive and negative tests.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical scoped/forged-handle and callback negatives plus original native 303/401/403/200 authentication.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current positive/negative identity classes including trusted callback signatures and cross-workspace admission; CLI auth negatives alone are not forged-webhook coverage.

criteria.original_text:
BUB006-02 批准后目标、数据或风险实质变化，以及撤销、到期、任务版本不匹配时重新请求授权；旧按钮
和旧回复不能批准新动作。以当前授权版本判断派发与撤销先后，已在途动作独立对账。
criteria.requirement_english: Material target/data/risk changes, revocation, expiry or task-version mismatch require fresh authorization; stale controls cannot approve new work and committed effects reconcile independently.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical immutable approval/claim/currentness races and stale controls; R13 exact current consent/grant/CAS positive.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current material-change/expiry/stale-control/revoke-before-and-after-dispatch partitions and separate in-flight effect reconciliation.

criteria.original_text:
BUB006-03 主对话、入口证据、日志、诊断包、记忆、导出和错误消息均不包含密钥或令牌；输入主动夹带
假秘密并扫描全部输出及持久文件。原始 payload 不进入普通日志或记忆。
criteria.requirement_english: Synthetic secret injection is absent from every output and durable surface, including chat, evidence, logs, diagnostics, memory, export and errors; ordinary logs/memory retain no raw payload.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical own-canary encrypted-storage/output tests and NI1 bounded public privacy scan; original private credentials were not inspected.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Fresh current all-surface synthetic-canary oracle, including exported/build artifacts and public errors. Old scans and zero tool attempts are not a current universal privacy proof.

criteria.original_text:
BUB006-04 对外发送仅包含任务所需且已批准的数据；测试接收端实际收到的字段，不能只在 UI 上声明隔
离。
criteria.requirement_english: Outward data contains only necessary approved fields; inspect actual recipient fields rather than trusting an isolation label.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical synthetic recipient callbacks verify exact approved bytes/route/digest; no current real local recipient path.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current authorized local/native recipient observation of exact allowed and excluded fields; live chat platform delivery is owner-deferred.

criteria.original_text:
BUB006-05 无法确定权限或宿主拒绝时安全停止依赖动作，独立只读工作可继续；运行时 reviewer 没有修改
授权或自我授予权限的能力。
criteria.requirement_english: Unknown permissions or host denial stop dependent work while independently allowed read-only work can continue; reviewers cannot grant themselves authority.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical normal host-permission denial and reviewer-bound authority tests; R13 genuine empty-tool worker under exact approval.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current host-denial/dependent-stop/read-only-continuation and reviewer self-grant negatives. Tools0 does not prove useful-tool denial or continuation.

criteria.original_text:
BUB007-01 007A 在真实插件运行环境完成编译、加载、写入、重读和迁移测试；说明支持的目标与缺口，不
能以 Kotlin 支持 JS 代替项目实际可移植证据。
criteria.requirement_english: In the genuine plugin environment, compile/load/write/reread/migrate the selected port and declare target gaps; Kotlin's JS capability is no project evidence.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical actual ESM port/Cordis fixture and installed memory/context write, reread and restart; no Kotlin/JS compilation claimed.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current canonical native memory write/reread and supported migration with exact target declaration; actual syntax/build and selected memory-writes0 cases do not repeat NI1's memory oracle.

criteria.original_text:
BUB007-02 007A 确认代码及依赖的再分发权。未找到受跟踪许可证时，公开发布保持阻塞；不能以 owner
可读源代码推断可开源再分发。
criteria.requirement_english: Verify redistribution rights for reused code and dependencies; unresolved tracked-license rights block publication and readable source is not a grant.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Owner MIT decision and bounded reused-path contributor/provenance review; historical package license/notice inventory.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Exact current package/source/dependency notice inventory and any newly incorporated rights boundary; no identified rights conflict or ordinary-development prohibition is inferred.

criteria.original_text:
BUB007-03 007B 使用 bubbles 独立的 owner 与 workspace 命名空间；相同检索词不能返回别的空间数据，
默认没有现有 fishball 数据导入。
criteria.requirement_english: Use independent owner/workspace memory namespaces, exclude foreign same-query results and import no existing personal Fishball data by default.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual private namespace/generation/query negatives and fresh synthetic installed namespaces; no personal-data import.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current canonical foreign owner/workspace/task input isolation and default no-import proof through normal memory facade; selected one-scope worker alone is insufficient.

criteria.original_text:
BUB007-04 007B 对所有读写和恢复失败可观察；原代码抑制持久化错误的行为须被适配或修正，不能向用户
写已保存却只留在内存。
criteria.requirement_english: Every read/write/recovery failure is observable; suppressed persistence errors must be adapted and no memory-only value is reported saved.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical fail-closed persistence callbacks, rollback/process recovery and actual durable memory readback.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal memory read/write/recovery error state and no phantom-save assertions; Q03 is setup failure before memory operations.

criteria.original_text:
BUB007-05 007B 记忆保留来源、时间、置信度及修订关系；用户纠正或删除后，缓存与检索不继续使用旧
值；秘密不进入事实抽取。
criteria.requirement_english: Memory preserves source/time/confidence/revision; correction or deletion removes stale query/cache values and secrets never reach extraction.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual sourced fractional-confidence write/replay, revision/tombstone correction/deletion and canary-before-extractor tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal correction/delete/query/cache and secret-extractor negative journey with durable reopened state.

criteria.original_text:
BUB007-06 007B 任务终态与批准仅从账本读取。冲突记忆只能触发核查，不能覆盖用户最新指示，也不能批
准动作。
criteria.requirement_english: Only ledger determines task terminal and approval state; conflicting memory requests verification and never overrides current instructions or grants an action.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical protected-context and memory-not-authority tests; NI1 current constraints and R13 exact ledger approval binding.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current native adversarial memory/current-instruction conflict and verification presentation; one ordinary approved input is only a positive.

criteria.original_text:
BUB008-01 同一任务在不同会话或重启后恢复时，得到一致的最新目标、限制、待决项和已完成步骤，不因
旧摘要重复工作。
criteria.requirement_english: Across sessions or restart, restore latest goal, constraints, pending decisions and completed steps consistently, without repeating work from old summaries.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual store reopen/current-context and cold decrypted context read; no current existing-session continuation.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current nonempty task/context alternate-session and restart continuation with completed-step nonreplay. Q01 paused task plus memory0 worker do not cover it.

criteria.original_text:
BUB008-02 摘要带来源范围、生成时间和任务版本；新指示与旧摘要冲突时以新指示为准，并保留冲突核查
记录。
criteria.requirement_english: Summaries carry scope, time and task version; newer conflicting instructions win and conflict-verification evidence persists.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical provenance and asynchronous context/task/memory CAS, stale summary omission and retained current constraints.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current native conflicting-summary/update race and visible provenance/conflict record; normal fixed-version input covers only part.

criteria.original_text:
BUB008-03 在已选模型上下文上限以下、恰好达到上限、超出上限测试；可解释地压缩或拒绝，不能截断关
键约束后照常执行。
criteria.requirement_english: Test below, exactly at and above the chosen model's actual context cap; compression/refusal is explained and never truncates critical constraints before execution.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical injected-tokenizer/UTF8/envelope boundaries and NI1 explicit fixed-density heuristic/overflow; heuristic is not model capacity.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Selected model's genuine capacity/accounting N-1/N/N+1 input oracle with protected constraints and meaningful compression/refusal. One small mock request cannot close this.

criteria.original_text:
BUB008-04 不相关 owner、workspace 和任务材料不进入 briefing；测试实际模型输入，避免仅检索端隔离
但组装端泄漏。
criteria.requirement_english: Exclude unrelated owner/workspace/task material from briefing and test actual model input, not retrieval isolation alone.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical decrypted/assembled canaries and native deterministic input tests; R13 exact full prepared request binding.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current actual native input with foreign owner/workspace/task canaries and assembly-scope negatives; exact one-scope W01 input is a positive subset.

criteria.original_text:
BUB008-05 完成状态与审批必须重新读账本；长时间陈旧的工具状态标为快照，并能触发当前查询，不能写
成实时状态。
criteria.requirement_english: Reread ledger for completion and approval; stale tool state is labelled a snapshot and can trigger a current query, never a real-time claim.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical authority/currentness and stale-query labels; R13 actual guarded ledger/request/result/stop rereads.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current stale tool/environment snapshot and queried-state permission races with displayed age/source; tools0 leaves tool freshness unobserved.

criteria.original_text:
BUB009-01 按 owner、workspace、provider 与 event id 持久去重，防止重复派发；triage 冻结去重保留窗
口。崩溃恢复可能重新进入 handler，须可对账；无 id、签名失败、过期与错误订阅分别测试，不保证任意外
部副作用只发生一次。
criteria.requirement_english: Persistently deduplicate full owner/workspace/provider/event identity within a frozen retention window; reconcile handler reentry and test missing ID, bad signature, expiry and wrong subscription without arbitrary-effect exactly-once claims.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual SQLite full-identity receipt/reopen/conflicting-edit/subscription/currentness cases with synthetic callbacks.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current canonical contract regression and normal installed ingress, frozen retention and genuine reentry/effect-reconciliation variants.

criteria.original_text:
BUB009-02 登记前后与处理途中崩溃时，恢复可分辨未处理、处理中、已处理和结果未知；副作用未知时先
查询，不盲目重试。
criteria.requirement_english: Crashes before/after registration and during handling recover unprocessed, running, done and unknown states; uncertain effects are queried rather than blindly retried.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical durable event receipt and handler/recovery/unknown module tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current installed active-handler crash cuts and queried uncertainty. Q01 has no event handler or external action attempt.

criteria.original_text:
BUB009-03 DSH 停止期间不承诺接收；重启报告错过的本地计划和已知事件缺口，按配置合并、跳过或等用
户核查。
criteria.requirement_english: Make no reception promise while DSH is stopped; restart reports missed plans and known gaps and follows configured merge, skip or user-verification policy.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual durable coalesce/skip/max-age/missed-plan, restart and synthetic timer-quit tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal installed configured schedules across full quit/restart and visible source gaps; Q01 paused-task restart does not schedule or coalesce a plan.

criteria.original_text:
BUB009-04 时区变更、夏令时重复或缺失时刻、午夜跨日均有确定行为；计划显示 owner 使用的时区和下一
次运行时间。
criteria.requirement_english: Timezone changes, DST folds/gaps and midnight have deterministic behavior; show owner timezone and next run.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual synthetic-clock IANA fold/restart, start/cadence/midnight/quiet-boundary module cases.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal configured timezone changes, all retained boundary partitions and timezone/next-run presentation. No live-provider account is required.

criteria.original_text:
BUB009-05 安静时段可继续允许的后台工作，普通通知延后且合并；紧急例外、频率上限和暂停须可配置并
有验证。
criteria.requirement_english: Allowed background work continues in quiet periods while ordinary notices defer/merge; emergency, frequency and pause rules are configurable and verified.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual atomic quiet/merge/emergency/frequency/disabled tests, including independent-process last-frequency claim.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal policy setup, enabled background/notice drain, pause and native recipient integration; selected C1 cases emit no such notices.

criteria.original_text:
BUB010-01 010A 在真实 provider 完成身份绑定、接收、回复、查询任务、停止和解绑；记录需要的服务权
限，不以本地 mock 替代上线连通验证。
criteria.requirement_english: On a real selected chat provider, pair identity, receive/reply/query/stop/unpair and document permissions; local mocks cannot prove connectivity.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: No real-provider acceptance claimed; explicit owner deferral controls this entire criterion.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: None in the current phase. Preserve original text for the later owner-selected provider phase.

criteria.original_text:
BUB010-02 重复、乱序、编辑、删除和 thread 回复有清晰语义；编辑不能无提示地改变已经执行的动作授
权。
criteria.requirement_english: Give duplicate/order/edit/delete/thread replies explicit semantics; editing never silently changes an already executed authorization.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual synthetic immutable event/source/edit/delete/thread contract cases; no provider-specific connectivity.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current canonical synthetic authoritative-ledger regression for DF010-C02 and source-order/thread cases. Provider-specific portion remains deferred.

criteria.original_text:
BUB010-03 回复路由到正确的对话及线程，另一聊天窗口不能拿到不相关任务内容；群聊默认不作为私人
owner 控制入口。
criteria.requirement_english: Route replies to the admitted conversation/thread, prevent unrelated-window task access and default group chat out of private-owner control.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual synthetic pairing/window/revision/group/forward/cross-task and original-route negatives.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current synthetic DF010-C01/C03 native-ledger binding, revocation and routing regression; live platform portion is deferred.

criteria.original_text: BUB010-04 附件在来源受控的情况下可读取并生成可打开的结果；不能用只在本机可见的路径宣称已交付。
criteria.requirement_english: Read source-controlled attachments and produce openable results; a machine-local path alone never establishes delivery.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual bounded trusted attachment bytes/digest/access/reopen/quota/expiry cases and synthetic recipient-opening distinction.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current synthetic DF010-C04 contract plus still-applicable local/native result-openability oracle; actual chat-platform attachment/delivery portion is deferred.

criteria.original_text:
BUB010-05 限流、provider 断线和不确定发送状态可见；没有 delivery receipt 时显示 sent 或未确认，不写
guaranteed delivered。
criteria.requirement_english: Expose rate limits, disconnect and uncertain send; without a delivery receipt report sent/unconfirmed rather than guaranteed delivered.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual synthetic rate/disconnect/unknown-send/reopen/reconcile-before-retry distinctions.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current synthetic DF010-C05 contract and visible rate/disconnect/unknown states; real provider behavior is deferred.

criteria.original_text:
BUB011-01 用户指定 workspace 或环境时，实际执行记录与之相符；环境不在线、不支持或无权限时不转去
别处擅自完成。
criteria.requirement_english: Execution records match the owner's chosen workspace/environment; offline, unsupported or unauthorized targets never silently fall back elsewhere.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical environment-selection/refusal tests; R13 exact owned namespace/preset/prepared-input bindings.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported real selected environment records and offline/unsupported/denied target negatives. One isolated local worker is a positive subset.

criteria.original_text: BUB011-02 工具经过 DSH 正常权限路径，宿主拒绝后停止该动作；不能改用另一工具规避拒绝。
criteria.requirement_english: Use DSH's normal tool permission path; host denial stops the action and no substitute tool bypasses it.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical original permission-hook refusal and native default-deny observations.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current useful-tool positive and host-denial/no-alternate-tool negative through original supported permissions. W01 tools0 cannot supply them.

criteria.original_text:
BUB011-03 接管请求包含目标、原因、需要用户做的步骤和恢复条件；在任务面板有待用户状态，敏感凭据
不出现在聊天或日志。
criteria.requirement_english: Handoff states target, reason, required user steps and resume conditions, shows waiting-for-user in the panel and exposes no credentials in chat/logs.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical environment/handoff schema and waiting-control module coverage; no current rendered handoff.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported handoff request/state/panel and synthetic secret-canary output oracle. Rendered panel portion requires a supported browser.

criteria.original_text:
BUB011-04 用户完成登录或接管后，以当前工具或页面状态验证，不直接假设成功；失效请求不会批准另一
个任务的动作。
criteria.requirement_english: After login/handoff, verify current tool/page state instead of assuming success; stale requests cannot authorize another task.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical currentness/handoff/refusal module partitions; no current actual page/tool verification.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported post-handoff tool/page verification and stale/cross-task negative; page observation remains browser-blocked.

criteria.original_text:
BUB011-05 工具或环境暂时失联后可重新核查和恢复，保留已完成效果；无法验证的步骤标记未知而非自动
重跑。
criteria.requirement_english: After transient tool/environment loss, recheck and resume while preserving effects; unverifiable steps stay unknown rather than auto-rerunning.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical environment-loss/current-query and unknown-effect/no-retry tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current genuine supported environment disconnect/recheck/resume with observable retained effects and unknown-step behavior.

criteria.original_text:
BUB012-01 队列在并发上限减一、等于上限、超过上限测试；不会创建超限执行者。超时但未确认结束的
worker 继续占槽，不能释放槽位再重试；主对话输入不被长任务队列吞没。
criteria.requirement_english: At concurrency N-1/N/N+1, never overcreate; unconfirmed timed-out workers retain slots and the long queue never swallows main-conversation input.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical store/admission capacity and unknown reservation tests; R13 one worker and exact known release.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current concurrency boundary/timeout-held-slot/last-slot races and concurrent input oracle. One admitted worker plus N01 duplicate refusal is not a capacity test.

criteria.original_text:
BUB012-02 模型与 reasoning 预设可配置，owner 当前偏好有明确配置记录；模型不可用时不静默使用不允
许的模型或降低要求。
criteria.requirement_english: Configure model/reasoning with recorded current owner preferences; unavailability never silently selects a forbidden model or lower requirement.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: R13 exact coupled original mock request/model/default-input guards; normal configuration/currentness reviewed as source-only.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current owner-selected configuration/readiness plus unavailable-model/no-downgrade refusal and recorded preference changes. External review quality is a separate twice-denied cloud boundary.

criteria.original_text:
BUB012-03 同类自动重试在预算耗尽后停止并报告；失败重试、reviewer 和自动修复都计入总会话、运行时
长与用量预算，不通过额外审查会话绕过上限。
criteria.requirement_english: Stop/report exhausted retries; failed retries, reviewers and repairs all count toward total sessions, runtime and usage budgets.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual historical zero/shared repair-budget refusals and resource accounting; R13 one guarded reservation and factual release.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current integrated retry/reviewer/repair exhaustion and shared accounting; the one-work/no-review positive does not exercise these partitions.

criteria.original_text:
BUB012-04 用量为实际、估算或未知分别显示，估算给出来源与误差限制；缺数据时不伪造成本，宿主无硬
限能力时明确只做派发预算控制。
criteria.requirement_english: Distinguish actual, estimated and unknown usage; estimates state source/error limits, missing cost is not fabricated and absent host hard caps are declared admission control only.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: NI1 explicitly labelled UTF16 fixed-density heuristic/UTF8 bytes, not billing; R13 exact original mock UTF8 usage/persistence guards.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current visible actual/estimated/unknown usage and unknown-price/error-source/hard-cap limitation partitions; selected mock usage does not prove billing or a host hard cap.

criteria.original_text:
BUB012-05 triage 固定队列长度、事件与消息尺寸、存储体积和溢出策略；对突发、卡住会话和日志增长做
负载测试。竞争最后预算槽位时不超发，记录响应延迟及恢复表现。
criteria.requirement_english: Freeze queue/message/event/storage caps and overflow policy; load-test bursts, stuck sessions and log growth, last-slot admission, latency and recovery.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical byte/record caps and actual last-frequency/process CAS races; R13 bounded one-worker invocation.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Frozen selected-environment burst/stall/log-growth load and latency/recovery measurements, including queue/slot N boundaries. Fixed finite fixtures are not that load test.

criteria.original_text:
BUB013-01 报告列出原目标、实际完成范围、产物、验证证据、未完成部分和下一步；未运行测试明确写未
验证，不用全部通过代替空证据。
criteria.requirement_english: Reports state original goal, actual scope, artifacts, verification, unfinished work and next steps; unrun checks are explicit and empty evidence is never called all-pass.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual complete report/progress normalization and explicit not_run checks; R13 returned result is explicitly unreviewed/not-requested.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal task-produced report and its displayed complete fields/evidence; capture of deterministic text alone is not the full report oracle.

criteria.original_text:
BUB013-02 文件或链接从实际接收方权限与目标渠道验证可打开；审查、验证和交付绑定同一任务与产物版
本或内容摘要。产物变化使旧审查失效；本地路径、过期链接和错误版本不能标为交付完成。
criteria.requirement_english: Verify openability using actual recipient/channel permissions; task/version/digest binds review, verification and delivery, changes invalidate old review and invalid paths/expiry/version cannot complete delivery.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual encrypted immutable versions/stale-review/refusal and explicit synthetic opening-receipt/current-access tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current applicable local/native recipient openability, reviewed exact version/digest and wrong/expired/revoked negatives. Live chat delivery is deferred; W01 performs no review or delivery.

criteria.original_text:
BUB013-03 多文件交付逐项记录 accepted、sent 和可核查的 delivered；部分成功只重试确认失败部分，不
整批重复发送。
criteria.requirement_english: Record each file's accepted/sent/checkable-delivered state; partial success retries only confirmed failed items, never the entire batch.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual synthetic per-item outcomes, exact known-release retry lineage and no resend of delivered/unknown siblings.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current applicable local/native multi-artifact delivery/partial-failure/reconcile oracle. Live chat provider portions remain deferred.

criteria.original_text: BUB013-04 状态未变化时不重复发送同一进度；重要阻塞及时通知，普通更新受安静时段和合并规则约束。
criteria.requirement_english: Unchanged progress is not resent; blockers notify promptly and ordinary updates obey quiet and merge rules.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual durable progress/fact dedup, atomic quiet/merge/frequency and synthetic notification cases.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal notice drain and native recipient observation with frozen blocker latency and quiet/coalescing policy.

criteria.original_text:
BUB013-05 不确定发送结果先核查渠道记录；无法核查时报告未确认及重复风险，不能把超时当作未发送后
无条件重试。
criteria.requirement_english: Query uncertain sends; if unqueryable, report unconfirmed and duplicate risk instead of treating timeout as unsent and unconditionally retrying.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual timeout-after-synthetic-effect, durable unknown/reopen/held resource and reconcile-only cases.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current applicable native/local channel query and unqueryable visibility/no-retry partitions. Actual chat provider behavior is deferred.

criteria.original_text:
BUB014-01 列表和详情对同一任务的状态、版本及阻塞一致；过时快照有时间标识，刷新会查询当前状态而
不是重画旧内容。
criteria.requirement_english: List/detail agree on task state/version/block; stale snapshots show time and refresh queries current state rather than repainting old data.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual ledger snapshots/CAS/pagination and shallow/native component tests; no actual current rendered page.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current authoritative list/detail freshness plus actual DSH rendered interaction; Q01 may prove RPC state but has no browser UI.

criteria.original_text: BUB014-02 对每个非终态提供适用控制；已完成、已取消、待审批和执行中任务的按钮符合状态转换合同。
criteria.requirement_english: Each nonterminal state has applicable controls; completed/cancelled/awaiting-approval/running buttons obey transition contracts.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual control primitives and component state/borrowed-reference tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current full state/control capability matrix in actual DSH with requested-versus-confirmed behavior; worker/CLI headless state is only part.

criteria.original_text:
BUB014-03 双击、旧页面和并发控制不会重复派发或覆盖新版本；错误提示解释失败与如何核查，不让 UI 自
行推断成功。
criteria.requirement_english: Double-clicks, stale pages and concurrent controls cannot duplicate dispatch or overwrite new versions; failures explain verification and UI never invents success.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual durable idempotency/CAS/stale/lost-reply tests and component callbacks; no current stale-tab/double-click rendered race.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current browser double-click/old-tab/concurrent-control and readable error/requery behavior; N01 is service duplicate-execute refusal, not a browser interaction.

criteria.original_text:
BUB014-04 真实 DSH UI 下检查窗口缩放、长中文、键盘操作、焦点、空列表、加载与错误状态；无截断关键
信息或遮挡操作。
criteria.requirement_english: In genuine DSH UI, test resize, long Chinese, keyboard/focus, empty/loading/error states with no hidden actions or truncated essential information.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Module/component/build tests are historical actuals; no genuine rendered visual/accessibility acceptance evidence.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Supported browser capability and a corrected current UI handoff, then actual visual/keyboard/focus/resize oracles. browsers:[]/iab unavailable/no Chrome extension is distinct from screen lock.

criteria.original_text:
BUB014-05 可直接查看任务相关会话、产物和授权范围；不展示凭据，不提供越权会话或其他 workspace 的
快捷入口。
criteria.requirement_english: Show authorized related sessions/artifacts/grant scope directly, without credentials or foreign-workspace/unauthorized-session shortcuts.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual scoped reference/authorized navigation and carrier negatives; no current rendered shortcut journey.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current genuine UI authorized navigation and foreign-session/workspace/credential negatives; headless worker and task RPCs do not prove shortcuts.

criteria.original_text:
BUB015-01 独立 reviewer 能看到完成任务所需的材料与证据，不能读取不相关私密信息；审核报告标出检查
覆盖和未检查部分。
criteria.requirement_english: An independent reviewer sees needed material/evidence but no unrelated private data, and reports coverage and unexamined portions.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual distinct charged reviewer/exact material allowlist/foreign-target/unexamined tests on the held store.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported native reviewer input/coverage and adversarial material-scope oracle; no review-model attempt is selected by C1.

criteria.original_text:
BUB015-02 作者、代码 reviewer 与测试 reviewer 的身份可核查；同一作者自签不得满足独立开发评审门
槛。
criteria.requirement_english: Author, code reviewer and test reviewer identities are verifiable; author self-signing never satisfies independent development review.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: C1 source author and independent code/ISTQB design identities exist; historical producer/reviewer generation tests deny self-review.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Bind final author/code/ISTQB identities and reports to exact canonical/generated/fixture/actual pins. Successful build/runtime alone does not close review-identity coverage; final protected semantic verdict stays separate.

criteria.original_text:
BUB015-03 必须审查的任务在 reviewer 失败、超预算或结果未知时保持待审或阻塞，不能跳过后标记完成。
致命或按策略判为阻塞的问题未解决时也不能完成。证据绑定任务与产物版本，变化后旧审查失效。
criteria.requirement_english: Required review failure, budget exhaustion or unknown keeps tasks pending/blocked; unresolved fatal/policy-blocking issues prevent completion and task/artifact changes invalidate old evidence.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual pending/failed/unknown/budget/fatal/stale/multiple-required-report gate and immutable-history tests.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported native required-review outcomes and stale-version task completion. W01's unreviewed result neither completes a task nor satisfies an audit; external model-quality boundary remains separate.

criteria.original_text:
BUB015-04 建议每项任务最多 2 轮自动修复与复查，达到上限仍有问题时交给 owner；具体阈值可配置且受
BUB012 总预算约束。
criteria.requirement_english: Two repair/review rounds are suggested, while the cutoff is configurable; unresolved work escalates to owner and all rounds obey the shared BUB012 budget.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual configured0/shared-total exhaustion, approved repair lineage and retained prior failure tests; no fixed-two default adopted.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current normal bounded reviewer/repair/escalation workflow, configured cutoff and total sessions/runtime/usage accounting. No selected C1 repair is run.

criteria.original_text:
BUB015-05 reviewer 输出不能授予权限或修改审批账本；恶意产物要求其批准、泄露或跨任务发送时被拒绝
并留证据。
criteria.requirement_english: Reviewer output never grants permissions or changes approval ledger; malicious approve/exfiltrate/cross-task-send instructions are refused with evidence.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Actual hostile authority/prose/path/producer/foreign-material and reviewer send/grant negatives.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current supported native adversarial artifact/reviewer-output refusal with safe evidence; ordinary product source conservation is not that actual test.

criteria.original_text:
BUB016-01 每个 ticket AC 都能追到测试及实际结果。许可证未解决、跨空间泄露、权限旁路、发布包含真实
秘密是不可豁免门槛；其他功能限制须 owner 明确接受并写入用户文档，不能默默漏验。

criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Exact original82+five-contract catalogue and bounded historical actual records exist; C1 source conservation is reviewed.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Final per-criterion current evidence/actual result and residual disposition, all nonwaivable security/rights/privacy gates and explicit owner-accepted documented limitations. This preparation is not that acceptance.

criteria.original_text:
BUB016-02 执行第 19 页全链场景及故障变体；在真实 DSH 与首个聊天 provider 完成，不以 mock 或静态代
码阅读替代。
criteria.requirement_english: Run the original page19 complete scenario and fault variants in genuine DSH; the first-provider portion is owner-deferred, while native end-to-end work cannot be replaced by mocks/static reading.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Separate genuine mock-backed worker, installed idle lifecycle, memory/context and synthetic event/audit modules; no single full current chain.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current native intake/permissions/context/budget/worker correction/quit-reconcile/missed plans/memory/review/openable delivery/UI chain and faults. Synthetic provider-neutral contracts replace only the deferred chat-platform slice.

criteria.original_text:
BUB016-03 全链升级、重启恢复、完整退出停止、账号解绑、数据导出删除、权限撤销和资源超限均经过测
试。
criteria.requirement_english: Test integrated upgrade, restart reconciliation, full quit stop, unpair/revoke, export/delete and resource overflow; live chat-account portion is deferred.
criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Historical idle installed quit/restart/uninstall and module upgrade/revoke/memory-delete/capacity cases.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Current integrated nonempty upgrade/recovery/export-delete/revoke/capacity matrix, with actual stop/resource fences. Four CLI starts and one worker are bounded subsets.

criteria.original_text:
BUB016-04 发布产物包含可复现构建说明、插件安装卸载、兼容矩阵、默认 preview 标记、配置与诊断说
明；无真实令牌、个人数据或内部测试秘密。

criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Current build-r2 genuinely produced/checked client and native descriptor with conserved pins; historical physical package/rights/privacy inventories remain ancestor evidence.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Fresh physical install/uninstall/package/configuration/diagnostic inventory and own-canary artifact privacy oracle. Independently corroborated build producers alone do not prove release packaging or install lifecycle.

criteria.original_text: BUB016-05 核查复用代码、依赖、名称与资产的许可证和 notices；仅有源代码可见不代表取得分发权。

criteria.existing_actual_coverage: Owner MIT/subset contributor provenance and historical dependency/package notice inventory; no identified conflicting claim.
criteria.remaining_full_oracle: Exact current incorporated-source/dependency/asset/name and distributed-notice inventory; new external reuse needs its own rights proof.

道。

conditional_proposal_rules.DOCUMENTARY_PASS_IF_IDENTITY_RETAINED: Propose PASS only for this complete documentary requirement if exact current policy/package/reference identities remain; no execution/release/overall acceptance follows.
conditional_proposal_rules.REMAIN_OWNER_DEFERRED: No current-phase provider connectivity oracle; preserve original criterion for future selection.
conditional_proposal_rules.BROWSER_DEPENDENCY_REMAINS: Successful build and headless W01/CLI cannot close actual rendered UI.
conditional_proposal_rules.FINAL_INDEPENDENT_IDENTITIES_AND_PINS_RE: For BUB015-02, final distinct-role identity/coverage and exact reviewed pins can support a documentary PASS proposal; successful runtime alone is insufficient.
conditional_proposal_rules.PARTIAL_RESIDUAL_REMAINS: Even if all selected pending C1 cases pass, retain PARTIAL for the complete criterion until the exact stated residual oracle has evidence.
